fields.title: SVG procurement.gov.vc tender/award record
fields.description: One record per row. Shape depends on recordType: CURRENT_BID or CLOSED_BID (listType=current/closed, a bid-table row with reference number, title, PDF link, procuring entity, procurement type, tender type, submission deadline) or AWARD_DOCUMENT (listType=awards, one row per year+quarterly PDF document link). A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a request fails or is unreachable.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: Which list this record came from: 'list:current', 'list:closed', or 'list:awards'.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record, or 'none' on error.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on a failed run (blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

no.title: Row number
no.description: CURRENT_BID/CLOSED_BID only -- the portal's own row number within its table (not a stable ID across runs).

referenceNumber.title: Reference number
referenceNumber.description: CURRENT_BID/CLOSED_BID only -- the procuring entity's own bid reference code.

title.title: Title
title.description: What is being procured (CURRENT_BID/CLOSED_BID) or the document's quarter label (AWARD_DOCUMENT uses documentLabel instead).

pdfUrl.title: Document URL
pdfUrl.description: Direct link to the bid/ToR PDF (CURRENT_BID/CLOSED_BID) or the quarterly award-of-contracts PDF (AWARD_DOCUMENT).

procuringEntity.title: Procuring entity
procuringEntity.description: CURRENT_BID/CLOSED_BID only -- the ministry, project, or government body running this procurement.

tenderType.title: Tender type
tenderType.description: CURRENT_BID/CLOSED_BID only -- e.g. 'Invitation to Bid', 'Request For Expressions of Interest', 'Request for Quotation'.

submissionDeadline.title: Submission deadline
submissionDeadline.description: CURRENT_BID/CLOSED_BID only -- upstream free-text deadline, usually 'Month DD, YYYY @ H:MM a.m./p.m.'; sometimes blank upstream (a linked Terms of Reference row sharing its parent bid's deadline).

year.title: Year
year.description: AWARD_DOCUMENT only -- the calendar year this award document covers.

documentLabel.title: Document label
documentLabel.description: AWARD_DOCUMENT only -- which portion of the year this PDF covers, e.g. '1st Quarter', 'Full Year'.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across all record types -- rows missing a given column render blank.
